capture_notes: Recorded WAN captures were used for masN, minN because no LAN captures were recorded. These observe traffic crossing the router, not LAN-local traffic; timing and loss can differ across the router. See provenance.json for the interface used in each trial.
sample_unit: one cumulative network-vantage measurement per trial
dns_size: UDP payload bytes; TCP DNS size is unavailable in this extractor
limitations: Physical packetization, headers, retransmissions and timing differ from SMC abstractions.
New TCP connections count distinct observed SYN-without-ACK streams.
Legacy capture filenames provide second-resolution UTC start times, not readiness barriers.
